# X360 Manager v1.6.10

## Fixes

- **Canary install** — extracts into a `XeniaCanary` subfolder instead of overwriting locked files in your RetroBat roms directory.
- Prefers `xenia_canary.exe` and shows a clear message if Xenia/RetroBat still has files locked.
- Launch checks that the emulator path is a valid `.exe`.

## Tip

When downloading Canary, choose an empty folder such as `D:\RetroBat\emulators` — not your games/roms folder.

## Download

Install **X360-Manager-Setup-1.6.10.exe** (Windows 10/11, 64-bit).
